mechanism_narrative: A low level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals accommodative monetary policy, which reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 6.0%, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 6.0%, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low unemployment (UNRATE < 5.0%) and strong industrial production (INDPRO > 105.0) signals an overheating economy, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 5.0% AND INDPRO > 105.0, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, high consumer spending (RSAFS) and strong housing starts (HOUST) signal that the economy is approaching its peak, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS > 500000 AND HOUST > 1500 and the regime is late-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of industrial production (INDPRO > 105.0) signals robust economic activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 105.0, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A low level of non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS < 140000) signals a weakening labor market, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS < 140000, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) signals restrictive monetary policy, which increases discount rates for equity valuation and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of housing starts (HOUST > 1500) signals strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1500, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.
